item.title: Comórtas Peile Páidí Ó Sé review
Ireland win at England by double scores
item.description: England's Six Nations title hopes are effectively over after a 42-21 thrashing by Ireland at Twickenham's Allianz Stadium. It's a second defeat in three matches for Steve Borthwick's side, while the visitors now have two wins from three. Scotland have fought back to win 26-23 in Cardiff and inflict a third straight loss on Wales. item.title: Premier League review
item.description: Brighton have won 2-nil at Brentford to ease some pressure on boss Fabian Hurzeler. Albion's James Milner has also broken the record for most Premier League appearances in his 654th top-flight game. Strugglers Burnley got an injury time goal to hold 10-man Chelsea 1-all at Stamford Bridge. Advertisement Third placed Aston Villa also scored late to draw 1-all with Leeds. item.title: Galway defeat Armagh
item.description: Galway have handed Armagh a big loss in Division 1 of the LGFA National League. item.title: Pauls go top of Women’s Super League
item.description: Utility Trust St Pauls have won 72-66 away to Killester to go top of the Dominos Women’s Super League. In the Dominos Men’s Super League Garvey’s Tralee Warriors were 72-58 victors at Killester. Advertisement

item.title: Kerry get the win at Dublin
item.description: Kerry have won against Dublin in the Allianz Football League. The Kingdom were victorious in Croke Park by 1-16 to 1-10. The opening score was a Sean O'Shea two pointer in the 4th minute, Tadhg Morley adding to that to make it 3-0 to Kerry after 6 minutes. Dublin opened their account with an 8th minute point.
